operator: Crucero del Norte + Río Uruguay (Foz do Iguaçu ↔ Puerto Iguazú, AR international line)
notes:
International cross-border bus line (wikiroutes route 46082) linking Terminal de Transporte Urbano (TTU) Foz do Iguaçu, Brazil, with Terminal de Ómnibus Puerto Iguazú, Argentina, over the Tancredo Neves / Fraternity Bridge, with Brazilian and Argentine immigration/aduana stops. Two companies (Crucero del Norte, Río Uruguay) share the same physical alignment; modeled here as one route with representative trips per operator per direction.

Schedule evidence (viajeleve.net, essemundoenosso.com.br):
- Crucero del Norte FOZ→PIG: 08:00, 08:30, then 09:30,10:30,...,18:30 (hourly); PIG→FOZ: 07:00, then 07:30→17:30 hourly.
- Río Uruguay FOZ→PIG: 07:30, 08:30,...,18:30 (hourly); PIG→FOZ: 06:30→18:30 hourly.
- ~12 departures/day each direction, ~40 min avg headway, daily incl. weekends. Trip ~30 min / ~30 km. Fare ~R$10–15 / 600 ARS.

Stops: 5 evidenced anchor nodes with WGS-84 coordinates — TTU Foz (Av. JK, Centro), Brazil Receita Federal aduana at the Tancredo Neves bridge head, bridge midpoint, Argentina Centro de Frontera Iguazú (aduana/migraciones off RN12), and Terminal de Ómnibus Puerto Iguazú. The wikiroutes 46082 intermediate stops are address-range fragments (Av. das Cataratas / Av. JK / Av. Victoria Aguirre house-number ranges) that are not individually geocodable reliably, so they are not invented as separate stops.

Times: published clock departures used; intermediate stop_times interpolated over the ~30 min run. Immigration dwell not separately modeled. confidence 0.55: real route + real operators + real published departure times, but intermediate stop granularity and exact timing between border posts are approximated.
